Timeline/2011

Tools & languages

A shared toolkit for machine learning

A consistent software interface made established learning methods easier to use and compare.

Fabian Pedregosa and colleagues

The contribution

The scikit-learn paper describes a Python library that brings together supervised and unsupervised learning tools with an emphasis on usability, documentation, and integration with the scientific Python ecosystem.

What this does not establish

This milestone concerns research software and access to methods, rather than a new universal learning algorithm.

Why this date?

2011 is the journal paper date. It is not the software project start date.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
